candidate.name: Muhammad Rayyan Ahmed
credentials: M.Sc. Data Science (in progress), TU Ilmenau

letter.role_title: Working Student Data Analyst - Sales (All genders)
letter.opening: I am applying for the Working Student Data Analyst position in Sales. Helping a large e-commerce business understand its sales and customers through data is exactly the kind of analytics work I want to grow in alongside my M.Sc. in Data Science.
letter.profile_intro: I am an M.Sc. Data Science student at TU Ilmenau. Before moving to Germany I worked as a Business Analyst at Tapal Tea and in SAP data & analytics consulting at TallyMarks Consulting, building dashboards, data models and SQL-based reporting for business teams.

achievements.impact: I built a Power BI dashboard for the CEO comparing monthly sales against the fiscal-year plan
I used SQL analysis, data validation and reconciliation to keep reporting accurate across HR, finance, supply chain and procurement
I replaced a quality check where users opened an SAP report for each of thousands of materials and compiled results in Excel with a single SAP Analytics Cloud dashboard

letter.problems_section: In your team I would build and maintain analyses and reports with SQL and Excel, keep the data accurate, and present findings clearly to the sales team. Python is a plus for you and part of my toolkit from my studies.
letter.closing: I am available immediately for at least 20 hours per week for well over six months, and am happy to relocate to Munich. I would be glad to discuss how I can contribute.
letter.language_closing: I work in English (IELTS 8.0) and am currently learning German (A1).
